$comment: Rulers on 20 September 1378 of the western subject and catalogue records the subjects context names. Display text.

lordship_of_ireland.ruler: Lord Richard II (justiciar James Butler, Earl of Ormond)

isle_of_man.ruler: William Montagu, 2nd Earl of Salisbury, Lord of Mann

english_france.ruler: The Seneschal of Gascony and the Captain of Calais for Richard II

desmond.ruler: Gerald FitzGerald, 3rd Earl of Desmond (Gearóid Iarla)

lordship_of_the_isles.ruler: John of Islay, Lord of the Isles

orkney.ruler: No earl (royal captain for Haakon VI)

french_minor_lordships.house: Lesser fiefs of the French crown

comtat_venaissin.ruler: Papal rector and the cardinals at Avignon

castilian_magnates.ruler: Heads of the new Trastámara lineages
castilian_magnates.house: Enríquez, Villena, Guzmán, Manrique, Mendoza, Velasco

castilian_military_orders.ruler: Masters Fernando Osórez (Santiago) and Pedro Muñiz de Godoy (Calatrava)

aragon_kingdom.ruler: King Peter IV, with the Justicia of Aragon

sardinia.ruler: King Peter IV, through a governor at Cagliari

andorra.ruler: Co-princes Gaston III Fébus of Foix and Bishop Berenguer d'Erill of Urgell

ferrara.ruler: Marquis Niccolò II 'lo Zoppo', with his brother Alberto

romagna_minor_signorie.ruler: Guido III da Polenta (Ravenna), the Alidosi (Imola) and others

roman_baronial_houses.ruler: Heads of the Colonna, Orsini, Savelli, Caetani and Prefetti di Vico

hainaut.ruler: Count William V (insane; Albert of Bavaria regent)

vaudemont.ruler: Countess Margaret of Joinville with Peter of Geneva

breslau.ruler: City council of Breslau for the king

upper_lusatia.ruler: Royal Landvogt and the Six Towns

rosenberg.ruler: Jan I and Oldřich I of Rosenberg

cilli.ruler: Count Hermann I (with his nephew William)

fribourg.ruler: Schultheiss and council under Habsburg lordship

faroes.ruler: Lawman and royal officials for Haakon VI

norse_greenland.ruler: Farmers' assembly under the Norwegian crown
